cards.title: Today's plan
cards.content:
{% set p = 'sensor.heating_eco_plan' %}
**{{ state_attr(p, 'reason') or 'No plan yet' }}**

{% if state_attr(p, 'block_start') %}| | |
|---|---|
| Expensive block | {{ as_timestamp(state_attr(p, 'block_start')) | timestamp_custom('%H:%M') }}–{{ as_timestamp(state_attr(p, 'block_end')) | timestamp_custom('%H:%M') }} |
| Block price | {{ (state_attr(p, 'block_mean_price') * 100) | round(1) }} c/kWh |
| Day median | {{ (state_attr(p, 'median_price') * 100) | round(1) }} c/kWh |
| Preheat from | {{ as_timestamp(state_attr(p, 'preheat_start')) | timestamp_custom('%H:%M') if state_attr(p, 'preheat_start') else 'no preheat' }} |
| Plan now | {{ states(p) }} °C |
| Applied target | {{ states('sensor.heating_eco_target') }} °C ({{ state_attr('sensor.heating_eco_target', 'reason') }}) |
{% endif %}
